verdict.rationale: Anrok's API docs show only single-item endpoints: one transaction per createOrUpdate, void, or createNegation call, and one customer per retrieve call. The list endpoint only reads data, and the many-to-1 product mapping links catalog items to a tax product rather than running an operation across many items. Neither is a documented bulk or batch capability, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
